subject: Chest
text: In the Gerudo's Training Ground, breaking a crate reveals a rusted switch that can be hammered to make a big chest appear containing the Ice Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Break it to find a rusted switch.
Hammer it to make a big chest appear above you...Open it for ICE
ARROWS!

subject: Chest
text: At the entrance of the Spirit Temple as Adult Link, a chest up the stairs contains Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
Enter the temple as Adult Link. Go up the stairs and open the chest for some
Bombchus.

subject: Chest
text: Bombing a rock to the right of the hall reveals an eye switch that makes a chest appear with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
look
to the right of the hall to see a rock. Bomb it to find an eye switch. Shoot it
and open the chest that appears for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Chest
text: Shooting the crystal switch on the pillar makes another chest appear containing Bombchus.

evidence.quote:
on the pillar, is a crystal switch sticking out.
Shoot it to make another chest appear containing more Bombchus.

subject: Torch Slug
text: Torch Slugs can be defeated by stunning them with Deku Nuts, jump striking them to extinguish their fire, and jump striking them two or three more times.

evidence.quote:
take out the Torch Slugs by first stunning them with Deku Nuts
(they're actually useful? =O ) and then jump striking them to take away their
fire, then jump strike them two or three more times to defeat them.

subject: Chest
text: A chest in the room to the left of the eye switch contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Open the chest in this new room to get the DUNGEON MAP

subject: Anubis
text: Anubis can be killed with Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
kill the Anubis
with Din's Fire.

subject: Gibdo
text: Gibdos can be stunned with Sun's Song and slashed to death.

evidence.quote: Stun the Gibdo with Sun's Song and slash it to death.

subject: Eye switch
text: Using a Bombchu to destroy the rock across the pit reveals an eye switch that creates an ice block over the pit when shot.

evidence.quote:
use a Bombchu to destroy it. Yep, it'll cross the pit. This will
reveal an eye switch. Shoot it to make an ice block appear over the pit.

subject: Stalfos
text: The Stalfos on the spinning platform can be pushed off and killed by slashing him when he is near the edge.

evidence.quote:
duel a Stalfos. Quite a
challenge as Young Link, but you can push him off by slashing him when he's
near the edge, killing him easily.

subject: Chest
text: The chest in the room following the spinning platform Stalfos contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door that opens. (It points you to
it.) Open the chest here for a Small Key.

subject: Chest
text: Defeating the Baby Dodongos and the Beamos at the top spawns a chest containing Bombchus.

evidence.quote: the Baby Dodongos and the Beamos for a chest containing Bombchus.

subject: Sun face
text: Destroying the section of wall with a Bombchu shines light onto the floor sun face, making a small chest appear on a ledge.

evidence.quote:
Send a Bombchu up there to destroy
part of the wall, shining light onto the sun face on the floor, making a small
chest appear on a ledge.

subject: Big chest
text: Shooting the eye switch on the side of the statue reveals a big chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Drop down and shoot
it to reveal a big chest. Open it for the COMPASS.

subject: Frozen eye switch
text: The frozen eye switch to the south can be melted by getting underneath it and using Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
Can't use Fire Arrows as Young Link, so get under it and use
Din's Fire.

subject: Chest
text: Shooting the eye switch in the hole makes a chest appear containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Shoot the eye switch in the hole to make a chest appear
containing a Small Key.

subject: Blue switch
text: Placing the box on the blue switch on the statue's hand keeps the door open.

evidence.quote:
Place the box on the blue switch to
keep a door opened back up where you were.

subject: Sun blocks
text: Pushing sun blocks into the light can open doors, summon a chest with a Heart inside, or summon Wallmasters.

evidence.quote:
push/pull sun blocks into the light shining through
until you open the door ahead...Other sun blocks open the door you came out of, summon
a chest with a Heart inside, and summon Wallmasters.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: To defeat the Iron Knuckle as Young Link, approach him, backflip as he begins to slash, jump slash when he is open, and backflip away.

evidence.quote:
Approach, as soon as he starts to slash, backflip,
jump slash when he's open, and backflip again. Repeat until he's dead.

subject: Chest
text: The chest outside past the Iron Knuckle contains the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote:
grab the
SILVER GAUNTLETS from the chest.

subject: Chest
text: Longshotting to the ledge chest revealed by the sun face earlier yields a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Remember the chest that
appeared on a ledge earlier ago? Longshot to it and open it for a Small Key.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Pushing the sun block south of the crystal switch into the light creates an ice block high above that leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Push/pull the sun block south of the crystal switch to the light. This
will make an ice block appear high above. Longshot up there, then find the Gold
Skulltula on another ice block and Longshot it and its token.

subject: Chest
text: Killing all the Beamos with Bombs spawns a chest containing arrows.

evidence.quote:
Immediately
kill all the Beamos with Bombs, and a chest containing arrows will appear.

subject: Song of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time twice near the blue blocks makes a small box appear to hold down the blue switch.

evidence.quote:
move toward the blue
blocks and play the Song of Time twice to make a small box appear. Grab it and
place it on the blue switch to keep the door ahead open.

subject: Freezing trap chest
text: Slashing the trap chest that would otherwise freeze Link causes the door to open.

evidence.quote:
slash the chest here (yeah, slash it) to make a door
open. Enter the door. (That chest, when opened, would've frozen you.)

subject: Chest
text: The chest outside past the second Iron Knuckle contains the Mirror Shield.

evidence.quote:
Grab the MIRROR SHIELD from the chest, then head
back in.

subject: Chest
text: Killing the Gibdo in the room unlocked with the Mirror Shield allows Link to open the chest for the Boss Key.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gibdo there and open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

subject: Chest
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol on the statue's left hand makes a chest appear behind crates below containing a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
See the Triforce symbol on the statue's left hand? Roll over
to it using the Hover Boots, then play Zelda's Lullaby to make a chest appear
behind some crates below. Drop down, break them, and open the chest for a Blue
Rupee.

subject: Three unlit torches
text: Shooting Fire Arrows at all three unlit torches lights them and opens the eastern door on the 2nd floor.

evidence.quote:
look for three unlit torches. Shoot Fire Arrows at all of them to
light them, opening the eastern door in this room on the 2nd floor.

subject: Sun faces
text: Lighting the sun faces with the Mirror Shield spawns Wallmasters that open the floor gate once defeated.

evidence.quote:
light the sun faces with the Mirror 
Shield to spawn the rest of the Wallmasters. Kill them one by one to make the
gate on the floor open up.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the ceiling of the west room and can be collected with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
Just look up towards the ceiling to
see a Gold Skulltula. Longshot it and its token

subject: Chest
text: Killing or letting the purple Leever disappear causes a chest to appear containing a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
start fighting Leevers until a purple (?)
Leever appears. Kill it or let it disappear to make a chest appear. Climb up and 
Longshot to the chest for a Purple Rupee as your prize.

subject: Chest
text: Collecting the remaining Silver Rupees under the rocks makes a chest appear with a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Bomb/hammer the remaining rocks for the last two Silver
Rupees to make another chest appear. Open it for a Small Key.

subject: Song alcoves
text: Playing the Song of Time, Epona's Song, Sun's Song, Song of Storms, and Zelda's Lullaby in sequence in the matching alcoves opens the door behind the Moblin.

evidence.quote:
play the Song of Time in this
small alcove to open another alcove. Head in there, play Epona's Song to open
another, play the Sun's Song in the next, the Song of Storms in the next, and
finally Zelda's Lullaby in the last...Anyway, doing this will
open the door behind the Moblin.

subject: Chest
text: In the Big Skulltulas room, killing all the Big Skulltulas allows opening the chest for a Purple Rupee.

evidence.quote:
kill all the Big Skulltulas immediately, then open the
chest for a Purple Rupee.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located in the room with the Big Skulltulas.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula in here as well.
